name: @edms/utils
description: Pure helpers with no domain meaning, shared by every Munaxa Docs app and package.
//exports: Narrow entry points exist because the barrel is not browser-safe: `uuid.ts` imports `node:crypto`, so a client bundle that reached the root export would fail to build. `./pagination` is pure arithmetic and constants, and the web app's URL-held list state needs the page-size bound without needing an identifier generator.
